terms.gloss: pay off, discharge (a debt, a price); literally untie, release
evidence: Cic. Att. 16.6.3: nōmina mea, per deōs, expedī, exsolve (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: In comedy it is mostly the literal word, untie or set free: exsolvite istum (Plaut. Bacch. 862).

phrases.latin: nōmina mea, per deōs, expedī, exsolve
phrases.english: for heaven’s sake, settle my debts and pay them off

phrases.latin: prope est quandō erus ob facta pretium exsolvet
phrases.english: the day is near when master will pay me what my deeds have earned
